high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the Lollapalooza India festival scheduled for January 24-25, 2026, at Mahalaxmi Race Course in Mumbai. The poster features a vibrant and colorful design with various artistic elements such as abstract shapes, patterns, and illustrations of hands and eyes.
